title: Local structure of a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf flat at a point, by elementary etale neighbourhood and open subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The proposition is the local structure theorem for a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf that is flat at a point: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image point there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the relevant point over which the pullback is finitely presented and flat over the localised base (statement lines 2476-2496, tag 05I5). The counted first proof is a long genuine induction: it reduces to the affine local case, uses the elementary devissage to reach a smooth morphism with geometrically irreducible fibres of dimension n, disposes of n = 0 through the open immersion criterion, and then finds a finite free submodule with flat cokernel whose fibre support has strictly smaller dimension, applying the induction hypothesis and inferring flatness and finite presentation from the resulting short exact sequence. The induction step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
